fields.label: Monthly Price List
fields.description: The only rental price list. Holds the agreed monthly rate per rental item. No daily or weekly lists exist by design (Q-01).

fields.label: Pricing Policy Confirmed
fields.description: Ticked once Q-14 to Q-18 are answered. While unticked, no rent is calculated and no rental invoice is raised.

fields.options: Confirmed by the client on 17 Sep 2026: actual days in the month; no minimum period (logistics, damage and deposits are compensated separately); any part day is a full day; one divisor for the whole hire - the day count of the month in which the hire starts; the prorated amount may exceed the monthly rate (no cap). Change these only on a new client decision.

Fixed 30 Days
Actual Days in Month
fields.label: Divisor Policy (Q-14)
fields.description: Divide the monthly rate by a fixed 30, or by the actual day count of the calendar month. Commercially material: at a fixed 30, a full January bills more than the monthly rate and a full February bills less.

fields.label: Minimum Rental Period Applies (Q-15)
fields.description: Unset means undecided, which is not the same as No.

fields.label: Part Day Policy (Q-16)
fields.description: A machine out 09:00 Monday and back 14:00 Wednesday is 2 days 5 hours.

fields.options:
Single Divisor For Whole Hire
Split At Month End
fields.label: Calendar Month Crossing (Q-17)
fields.description: Single Divisor: the whole hire uses the day count of the month it starts in. Split: each day is charged at the rate of its own month.

fields.label: Monthly Rate Is A Cap (Q-18)
fields.description: Yes = a hire of a month or less never bills more than the monthly rate. No = bill as calculated, even above the monthly rate.

fields.label: Default Yard Location
fields.description: Proposed as the dispatch yard and the receiving yard.

fields.label: Overdue Surcharge %
fields.description: Zero means no surcharge, which is a safe default rather than an assumed policy.

fields.label: Block Dispatch If Credit Limit Exceeded
Damage Recovery Income Account
fields.description: Optional. Overrides the income account on damage recovery lines.

fields.label: Security Deposit Liability Account
fields.description: A Liability ledger (not a group, no account type) that holds refundable security deposits.

fields.label: Damage Recovery Item
fields.description: Non-stock service item used on damage recovery invoices.

fields.label: Transport Charge Item
fields.description: Non-stock service item used for mobilisation and demobilisation charges.
